rule_title: RHEL 9 must audit any script or executable called by cron as root or by any privileged user.
check_text:
Verify RHEL 9 is configured to audit the execution of any system call made by cron as root or by any privileged user.

$ sudo auditctl -l | grep /etc/cron.d
-w /etc/cron.d -p wa -k cronjobs

$ sudo auditctl -l | grep /var/spool/cron
-w /var/spool/cron -p wa -k cronjobs

If either of these commands do not return the expected output, or the lines are commented out, this is a finding.

checks.description: Verify RHEL 9 is configured to audit the execution of any system call made by cron as root or by any privileged user.
